# common constant tempo map

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tempoMapCommon`](gmeow-tempoMapCommon.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tempoMapCommon>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A simple constant [`TempoMap`](../classes/gmeow-TempoMap.md) used by the meter fixtures: one quarter-note beat in [`musicalTimeFrameCommon`](gmeow-musicalTimeFrameCommon.md) maps to one half-second in TAI (e.g. quarter = 120). The solver interprets the ratio relative to the declared frames.
